obsSpec.comment: Feature order is the contract between lib/policy/spec.ts and training/envs/live_webrtc_env.py. Both build this vector from raw per-viewer telemetry, never from the discretized Q-table bins. Per-viewer blocks are always emitted for slot 0 and slot 1; when viewers=1, slot 1 is filled with neutral values (NEUTRAL_SLOT) rather than omitted, so one exported model can serve both room sizes.
